user_intent_summary: Design a small storage box with a hinged lid that stays closed until released by a thumb, using additive manufacturing, and ensuring safety, ease of assembly, and practical manufacturing.
product_intent: A small storage box with a hinged lid that remains closed until intentionally opened by user thumb pressure, constructed through additive manufacturing techniques while meeting safety, assembly, and manufacturing requirements

clauses.text: Design a small storage box with a hinged lid
The lid should stay closed until the user releases it with a thumb
The box should be safe to use

requirements.statement: The storage box must have a hinged lid that remains closed until intentionally released by thumb pressure

verification.observable: Lid remains closed until thumb pressure applied to release mechanism
verification.condition: Thumb pressure applied to lid release point

requirements.statement: The storage box must be safe to use

verification.observable: Absence of sharp edges, toxic materials, or hazardous components

requirements.statement: The storage box must be easy to assemble

verification.observable: Assembly can be completed within specified time and with minimal tools

requirements.statement: The storage box must be practical to manufacture
The storage box must operate manually without electrical or mechanical assistance

verification.observable: Operation requires only manual thumb pressure
verification.condition: Product tested with no external power source

requirements.statement: The storage box must be constructed using additive manufacturing techniques

verification.observable: Construction method used is additive manufacturing

requirements.statement: The storage box must be desktop-sized

verification.observable: Product dimensions conform to desktop-sized specification

freedoms.subject: The specific mechanism for the lid release
freedoms.statement: The user does not specify how the lid is to be released, only that it stays closed until released with a thumb

relations.rationale: The lid release mechanism must be manual operation compatible

operating_scenarios.name: Normal use scenario
operating_scenarios.description: User places items in storage box and closes lid manually, then applies thumb pressure to open lid for access

operating_scenarios.name: Manufacturing scenario
operating_scenarios.description: Product is constructed using additive manufacturing techniques with safety, assembly ease, and manufacturability requirements met

assumptions.statement: The term 'desktop-sized' has a standard definition that allows for reasonable product dimensions

unknowns.subject: Specific dimensions for desktop-sized product
unknowns.reason: The request does not specify exact measurements for 'desktop-sized' but requires it be a standard desktop size
